title: Year 9 Basic Technology Textbook Knowledge Map
source: YEAR 9 Basic Technology Txt Bk Amended (1) - eidted.pdf
copyright_note: Use as an authorised/reference source. Do not reproduce the full textbook in the application unless permission/licensing permits it.
purpose: Map the Year 9 textbook into IA-Tutor so the AI can retrieve relevant topics, explain concepts, guide worksheet work, and analyse uploaded student drawings/questions.

chapters.name: Plane Geometry
topics: Preparing A4 Sheet and Paper Layout
Types of Lines and Their Uses
Division of Lines, Angles, Arcs and Circles

ai_behaviour.student_text_question: Identify the relevant Year 9 topic, retrieve the relevant source context, explain in simple language, then provide a worked solution or guided steps.
ai_behaviour.student_photo: Inspect the uploaded worksheet/drawing, extract visible text and dimensions, identify the topic, compare against the textbook method, and produce a step-by-step answer. Never invent unreadable dimensions; ask for a clearer image when required.
ai_behaviour.technical_drawing: Where the question is a drawing construction, identify required instruments, construction sequence, dimensions, projection/view type and expected final result. Generate CAD geometry only when the dimensions and construction are sufficiently clear.
ai_behaviour.worksheet_mode: Guide the student through the worksheet using the textbook as the learning source. Provide answers with explanations rather than unexplained final answers.
ai_behaviour.source_display: Show the relevant textbook chapter/topic and page reference to the student without reproducing the entire copyrighted textbook.
ai_behaviour.uncertainty: If the AI cannot confidently identify the question or drawing, explain what is uncertain and provide an option to escalate to human support.
